shell.fired.title: Your career is over
shell.fired.body: The firm did not renew your contract. Your record remains on the Career screen.
shell.turn.skipHint: Closes months until something is addressed to you. Twelve at most.
shell.turn.pending: {count, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} waiting
shell.turn.pendingHint: Decisions past their deadline take the second option.
shell.turn.news: {count, plural, one {# market news item} other {# market news items}}
shell.tip.phase: The cycle: expansion, slowdown, recession, recovery. In a recession earnings and deal multiples fall.
shell.tip.policyRate: The policy rate is the floor under acquisition debt. When it rises, interest costs more and lenders offer fewer turns.
shell.tip.valuation: Valuation index. 100 is the long-run average. Higher means you buy dear and sell dear.
shell.tip.credit: Credit spread: what lenders add to the policy rate. When it widens they cut how much they lend.
shell.tip.forSale: Sales you can see now. A sale being prepared shows only at relationship 40 or while you research the sector.
shell.tip.uncalled: Uncalled commitments: fund money not yet invested. After the investment period it cannot go into new deals.
